title: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data and on the free movement of such data, and repealing Directive 95/46/EC (General Data Protection Regulation), as published in the Official Journal, L 119, 4.5.2016, p. 1
fetch: HTTP GET with Accept: application/xhtml+xml and Accept-Language: eng, User-Agent legalese-commons-source-fetcher/1.0 (+https://github.com/legalese/commons), following redirects (curl -L); the resource answered 200 at the cellar URL above
role: the Regulation as published on 4.5.2016, UNCORRECTED: the corrigendum of 23.5.2018 (the other file in this folder) changes fifteen passages of it. It is the only one of the three texts that has the recitals (1)-(173), so it is the text for the recitals, which are reading aids and are not encoded. Recital 71 is corrected by the corrigendum; no deposited text carries the corrected recital. The Official Journal text is the authentic one; this file is a rendering of it by a script.
in_force: enters into force on the twentieth day after publication and applies from 25 May 2018 (Article 99 as published).

Quote Article 4 from the consolidated text, which has them. Paragraph breaks inside a recital or article follow the converter, one block per line.
